column1: # protected-paths.tsv — the paths only the maintainer may merge. An approval gate reads this register from the
# default branch: a PR touching any path below is queued for the maintainer's approval; a PR touching none may be
# merged unattended once its required checks are green for its exact head (.agents/required-checks.tsv).
# FORMAT  glob <TAB> class <TAB> reason. Globs are repo-relative and case-insensitive; `**` crosses directories,
# `*` and `?` do not. Always protected whatever this file says: this register, .agents/ship.conf and .github/**.
# A rename is judged on both of its paths, so moving a file into or out of a glob is protected.
# WHAT IS PROTECTED: a path whose change could weaken a guard or reach a machine unreviewed — this repo's
# governance and guard hooks, the scheduled units, the config that decides whether a merge is green, release
# inputs, and the modules that are the safety boundary of an agent run. Ordinary source, tests and docs are
# not: a change there is still held to every required check.
# .github/CODEOWNERS is generated from this file: uv run python .agents/scripts/gen_codeowners.py --write
